<chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Generate pseudo-random values for matrix N);\n}\n\nvoid initMatrix(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[i * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nvoid matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B, \n                    std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                sum += A[i * N + k] * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n            C[i * N + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Simple validation: compute a single element and compare\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,\n                   const std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N) {\n    // Check a few random positions\n    constexpr size_t checkPoints[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4};\n    \n    for (size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {\n        for (size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {\n            const size_t i = checkPoints[pi] % N;\n            const size_t j = checkPoints[pj] % N;\n            \n            double expected = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += A[i * N + k] * B[k * N + j];\n            }\n            \n            const double actual = C[i * N + j];\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n            \n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual, relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t N = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrices\n    std::vector<double> A(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> B(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> C(N * N);\n    \n    // Initialize matrices\n    printf(\"Initializing matrices...\\n\");\n    initMatrix(A, N);\n    initMatrix(B, N);\n    \n    // Perform matrix multiplication\n    printf(\"Computing matrix multiplication...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    matrixMultiply(A, B, C, N);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS\n    double gflops = (2.0 * N * N * N) / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(C, \"MatrixC\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateResult(A, B, C, N);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: ++k) {\n                const double a = A[i * N + k];\n                const double* b = &B[k * N];\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                    c[j] = std::fma(a, b[j], c[j]);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}","originalFile":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Cache blocking factor over the k dimension: a block of B rows stays hot while all local rows sweep it\nconstexpr size_t kBlock = 128;\n\n// Sample positions checked during validation\nconstexpr size_t kCheckPoints[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4};\n\n// Generate pseudo-random values for matrix initialization\nconstexpr double getPseudoRndValue(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {\n    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);\n}\n\n// First row owned by `rank` under a balanced block distribution; rank == size yields N\nconstexpr size_t rowBegin(const size_t N, const int rank, const int size) noexcept {\n    return N * static_cast<size_t>(rank) / static_cast<size_t>(size);\n}\n\n// Fills rows [rowBegin, rowEnd) of N columns; mat is indexed relative to rowBegin\nvoid initRows(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N, const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowEnd) {\n    for (size_t i = rowBegin; i < rowEnd; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[(i - rowBegin) * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Computes the local block C = A * B, where A and C hold `rows` rows and B is the full matrix.\n// Each C[i][j] accumulates its k terms in ascending order, so results match the ijk kernel exactly.\nvoid matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,\n                    std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N, const size_t rows) {\n    std::fill(C.begin(), C.end(), 0.0);\n    for (size_t kb = 0; kb < N; kb += kBlock) {\n        const size_t kEnd = std::min(N, kb + kBlock);\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {\n            double* c = &C[i * N];\n            for (size_t k = kb; k < kEnd; ++k) {\n                const double a = A[i * N + k];\n                const double* b = &B[k * N];\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                    c[j] += a * b[j];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Simple validation: recompute sampled entries and compare.\n// actual[pi][pj] holds C[i][j] for i = kCheckPoints[pi] % N, j = kCheckPoints[pj] % N.\nbool validateResult(const size_t N, const double actual[5][5]) {\n    for (size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {\n        for (size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {\n            const size_t i = kCheckPoints[pi] % N;\n            const size_t j = kCheckPoints[pj] % N;\n\n            double expected = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += getPseudoRndValue(N, i, k) * getPseudoRndValue(N, k, j);\n            }\n\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual[pi][pj] - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n\n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual[pi][pj], relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int size) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n    size_t N = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank, so all ranks take the same path)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", size);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Initializing matrices...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Each rank owns a contiguous block of rows of A and C; B is needed in full\n    const size_t r0 = rowBegin(N, rank, size);\n    const size_t r1 = rowBegin(N, rank + 1, size);\n    const size_t rows = r1 - r0;\n\n    std::vector<double> A(rows * N);\n    std::vector<double> B(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> C(rows * N);\n\n    initRows(A, N, r0, r1);\n    initRows(B, N, 0, N);\n\n    // Perform matrix multiplication\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing matrix multiplication...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    matrixMultiply(A, B, C, N, rows);\n\n    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double elapsed = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (root) {\n        const long durationMs = static_cast<long>(elapsed * 1000.0);\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", durationMs);\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS\n        double gflops = (2.0 * N * N * N) / (durationMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<int> counts(size);\n        std::vector<int> displs(size);\n        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n            const size_t begin = rowBegin(N, r, size);\n            const size_t end = rowBegin(N, r + 1, size);\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>((end - begin) * N);\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(begin * N);\n        }\n\n        std::vector<double> full(root ? N * N : 0);\n        MPI_Gatherv(C.data(), static_cast<int>(rows * N), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                    full.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (root) {\n            print_results(full, \"MatrixC\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        // Each sampled entry is owned by exactly one rank; a sum-reduction (with zeros elsewhere) assembles them\n        double sample[5][5] = {};\n        double total[5][5] = {};\n        for (size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {\n            for (size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {\n                const size_t i = kCheckPoints[pi] % N;\n                const size_t j = kCheckPoints[pj] % N;\n                if (i >= r0 && i < r1) {\n                    sample[pi][pj] = C[(i - r0) * N + j];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Reduce(&sample[0][0], &total[0][0], 25, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        int valid = 1;\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            valid = validateResult(N, total) ? 0 : 1;\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int status = run(argc, argv, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return status;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":35,"oldLines":7,"newStart":35,"newLines":8,"lines":[" }"," "," // Computes the local block C = A * B, where A and C hold `rows` rows and B is the full matrix.","-// Each C[i][j] accumulates its k terms in ascending order, so results match the ijk kernel exactly.","+// Each C[i][j] is accumulated as sum = fma(A[i][k], B[k][j], sum) for k ascending, the same operation","+// sequence as the original ijk kernel, so results are bit-identical while the j loop vectorizes."," void matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,","                     std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N, const size_t rows) {","     std::fill(C.begin(), C.end(), 0.0);"]},{"oldStart":47,"oldLines":7,"newStart":48,"newLines":7,"lines":["                 const double a = A[i * N + k];","                 const double* b = &B[k * N];","                 for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {","-                    c[j] += a * b[j];","+                    c[j] = std::fma(a, b[j], c[j]);","                 }","             }","         }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01XDLYFXb7Di4wvy7e9AAN7g","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

rank == size yields N\nconstexpr size_t rowBegin(const size_t N, const int rank, const int size) noexcept {\n    return N * static_cast<size_t>(rank) / static_cast<size_t>(size);\n}\n\n// Fills rows [rowBegin, rowEnd) of N columns; mat is indexed relative to rowBegin\nvoid initRows(std::vector<double>& mat, const size_t N, const size_t rowBegin, const size_t rowEnd) {\n    for (size_t i = rowBegin; i < rowEnd; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            mat[(i - rowBegin) * N + j] = getPseudoRndValue(N, i, j);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Computes the local block C = A * B, where A and C hold `rows` rows and B is the full matrix.\n// Each C[i][j] is accumulated as sum = fma(A[i][k], B[k][j], sum) for k ascending, the same operation\n// sequence as the original ijk kernel, so results are bit-identical while the j loop vectorizes.\nvoid matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,\n                    std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N, const size_t rows) {\n    std::fill(C.begin(), C.end(), 0.0);\n    for (size_t kb = 0; ++k) {\n                const double a = A[i * N + k];\n                const double* b = &B[k * N];\n                for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n                    c[j] = std::fma(a, b[j], c[j]);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Simple validation: recompute sampled entries and compare.\n// actual[pi][pj] holds C[i][j] for i = kCheckPoints[pi] % N, j = kCheckPoints[pj] % N.\nbool validateResult(const size_t N, const double actual[5][5]) {\n    for (size_t pi = 0; k < N; ++k) {\n                expected += getPseudoRndValue(N, i, k) * getPseudoRndValue(N, k, j);\n            }\n\n            const double relError = std::abs((actual[pi][pj] - expected) / (expected + 1e-10));\n\n            if (relError > 1e-6) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed at (%zu, %zu): expected %.10f, got %.10f (error: %.10e)\\n\",\n                       i, j, expected, actual[pi][pj], relError);\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size N (computes NxN * NxN) (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint run(int argc, char** argv, int rank, int size) {\n    const bool root = rank == 0;\n    size_t N = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank, so all ranks take the same path)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            N = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Matrix Multiplication Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", N, N);\n        printf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", size);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n        printf(\"Initializing matrices...\\n\");\n    }\n\n    // Each rank owns a contiguous block of rows of A and C; B is needed in full\n    const size_t r0 = rowBegin(N, rank, size);\n    const size_t r1 = rowBegin(N, rank + 1, size);\n    const size_t rows = r1 - r0;\n\n    std::vector<double> A(rows * N);\n    std::vector<double> B(N * N);\n    std::vector<double> C(rows * N);\n\n    initRows(A, N, r0, r1);\n    initRows(B, N, 0, N);\n\n    // Perform matrix multiplication\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Computing matrix multiplication...\\n\");\n    }\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    matrixMultiply(A, B, C, N, rows);\n\n    const double localElapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double elapsed = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&localElapsed, &elapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (root) {\n        const long durationMs = static_cast<long>(elapsed * 1000.0);\n        printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", durationMs);\n\n        // Calculate GFLOPS\n        double gflops = (2.0 * N * N * N) / (durationMs / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n        printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    }\n\n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        std::vector<int> counts(size);\n        std::vector<int> displs(size);\n        for (int r = 0; r < size; ++r) {\n            const size_t begin = rowBegin(N, r, size);\n            const size_t end = rowBegin(N, r + 1, size);\n            counts[r] = static_cast<int>((end - begin) * N);\n            displs[r] = static_cast<int>(begin * N);\n        }\n\n        std::vector<double> full(root ? N * N : 0);\n        MPI_Gatherv(C.data(), static_cast<int>(rows * N), MPI_DOUBLE,\n                    full.data(), counts.data(), displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (root) {\n            print_results(full, \"MatrixC\");\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        // Each sampled entry is owned by exactly one rank; a sum-reduction (with zeros elsewhere) assembles them\n        double sample[5][5] = {};\n        double total[5][5] = {};\n        for (size_t pi = 0; pi < 5; ++pi) {\n            for (size_t pj = 0; pj < 5; ++pj) {\n                const size_t i = kCheckPoints[pi] % N;\n                const size_t j = kCheckPoints[pj] % N;\n                if (i >= r0 && i < r1) {\n                    sample[pi][pj] = C[(i - r0) * N + j];\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Reduce(&sample[0][0], &total[0][0], 25, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        int valid = 1;\n        if (root) {\n            printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n            valid = validateResult(N, total) ? 1 : 0;\n\n            if (valid) {\n                printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            } else {\n                printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            }\n        }\n        MPI_Bcast(&valid, 1, MPI_INT, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        return valid ? 0 : 1;\n    }\n\n    return 0;\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n\n    const int status = run(argc, argv, rank, size);\n\n    MPI_Finalize();\n    return status;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":35,"oldLines":8,"newStart":35,"newLines":8,"lines":[" }"," "," // Computes the local block C = A * B, where A and C hold `rows` rows and B is the full matrix.","-// Each C[i][j] is accumulated as sum = fma(A[i][k], B[k][j], sum) for k ascending, the same operation","-// sequence as the original ijk kernel, so results are bit-identical while the j loop vectorizes.","+// Each C[i][j] accumulates its k terms in ascending order, the same operation sequence as the original","+// ijk kernel; the j loop is the innermost, so it vectorizes without reordering any sum."," void matrixMultiply(const std::vector<double>& A, const std::vector<double>& B,","                     std::vector<double>& C, const size_t N, const size_t rows) {","     std::fill(C.begin(), C.end(), 0.0);"]},{"oldStart":48,"oldLines":7,"newStart":48,"newLines":7,"lines":["                 const double a = A[i * N + k];","                 const double* b = &B[k * N];","                 for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {","-                    c[j] = std::fma(a, b[j], c[j]);","+                    c[j] += a * b[j];","                 }","             }","         }"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"tool_result_meta":[{"id":"toolu_01EDDWYsLrzj6LPASwnemnhp","permission_decision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reason_type":"mode"}}]}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfxXwgkkYeRw4rGacVoYo","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01GuS3E993dKDn3rtML5Q7hA","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /tmp/mmref && cat > orig_timer.cpp <<'EOF'\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <vector>\nconstexpr double g(const size_t N, const size_t i, const size_t j) noexcept {\n    return (((i + 1) * (i + j + 1) * 1299709) % (N * N)) / static_cast<double>(N * N);\n}\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    const size_t N = atoi(argv[1]);\n    std::vector<double> A(N*N), B(N*N), C(N*N);\n    for (size_t i=0;i<N;++i) for (size_t j=0;j<N;++j) { A[i*N+j]=g(N,i,j); B[i*N+j]=g(N,i,j); }\n    auto t0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    for (size_t i=0;i<N;++i) for (size_t j=0;j<N;++j) { double s=0.0; for (size_t k=0;k<N;++k) s+=A[i*N+k]*B[k*N+j]; C[i*N+j]=s; }\n    auto t1 = std::chrono::duration<double>(std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now()-t0).count();\n    printf(\"original kernel N=%zu: %.0f ms, %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", N, t1*1000, 2.0*N*N*N/t1/1e9);\n}\nEOF\ng++ -std=gnu++20 -O3 -march=native -ffp-contract=off orig_timer.cpp -o orig_timer && timeout 110 ./orig_timer 2048","description":"Time original serial kernel at N=2048 for comparison"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1006,"cache_read_input_tokens":71415,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1006},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8a3aa1d3-6d78-4117-ad39-2a440e43c342","uuid":"7a3af540-02bd-4062-8a91-c624b91c62ab","timestamp":"2026-10-12T14:53:56.041Z","request_id":"req_011CfxXwg4aBqeourvi3TakC"}

Only `matmul/matmul.cpp` and `matmul/CMakeLists.txt` changed, the executable is still `matmul`, and no files were added to the repo.\n\n**What changed**\n- **Distribution:** C and A are split into contiguous row blocks across ranks. Each rank generates its own rows of A and all of B locally, so nothing is broadcast. Only the rows of C are gathered, and only when `-r` is given.\n- **Validation:** `-v` reduces just the 25 sampled entries to rank 0, and the verdict is broadcast so every rank exits with the same status.\n- **Kernel:** The naive `ijk` loop is now `ikj` with k-blocking, so the inner loop is contiguous and vectorizes. Each C element still sums its terms in ascending k order, which keeps the results bit-identical.\n- **Timing:** Ranks synchronize with a barrier, and the reported time is the slowest rank's compute time.\n- **Output:** I added one line, `MPI ranks: N`. Everything else keeps the original format.\n- **CMake:** `find_package(MPI REQUIRED)`, links `MPI::MPI_CXX`, and adds `-ffp-contract=off`.\n\n**Correctness**\n- Compared against a serial reference that uses the original kernel and the same `print_results` code. The `-r` hashes are identical for N ∈ {1, 3, 5, 100, 257, 512} and P ∈ {1, 2, 3, 4, 7, 16}, including more ranks than rows.\n- `-v` passes at several rank counts, and `-h` and unknown options behave as before.\n\n**Performance** (N=2048, this machine)\n\n| Ranks | GFLOPS |\n|---|---|\n| original serial kernel | 0.17 |\n| 1 | 6.1 |\n| 2 | 12.2 |\n| 4 | 23.9 |\n| 8 | 49.9 |\n\n**Decision for you: `-ffp-contract=off`.** The original's default-flag build is not reproducible. GCC fuses some multiply-adds in its reference loop (at N=5, the default-flag hash differs from the unfused hash). I pinned the unfused arithmetic, so the output is the same on any compiler and any rank count. The cost is that the flag applies to the build generally. On this machine FMA made no measurable speed difference. If you need the output to match the original's default-flag build hash, that is not achievable exactly, and the choice would need to be revisited.\n\n**Limitations**\n- Each rank holds the full B matrix, so memory per rank is about N² doubles. The row-block layout is what keeps the work scaling; it does not reduce B's footprint.\n- Counts for `MPI_Gatherv` are `int`, so the `-r` path breaks past about N = 46,340. Practical sizes are far below that.\n- `-march=native` is unchanged, so every node in a cluster needs a compatible CPU."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":655,"cache_read_input_tokens":73411,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":655},"output_tokens":8,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"8a3aa1d3-6d78-4117-ad39-2a440e43c342","uuid":"7264f555-1ded-4b5a-8d18-a47be4e34354","timestamp":"2026-10-12T14:55:48.868Z","request_id":"req_011CfxY5tzBFLdvazEEvyjvg"}
